settings.antennaDesc: 5dBi vertical collinear, roof-mounted, Palace roof AGL

journal.title: Day Zero — Grid Down
journal.body: Power failed at 06:17. No comms. Decision made to shelter in place and begin asset inventory. Water pressure still holding from mains — unsure for how long. Begin rationing immediately.

journal.title: Water Pressure Gone
journal.body: Mains pressure dropped to zero at 13:52. Switched to stored supplies. Both IBC tanks confirmed full at approx 1000L combined. Berkey filter operational. Rationing to 3L per person per day.

journal.title: First Scavenging Run — Victoria Street
journal.body: Two-person team. Victoria Street SW1, 0.8km. Cleared Sainsbury's Local — approx 140 tins, 12kg pasta, 6 x 2L water. No contact. Area quiet. Fuel used: ~3L diesel. Return 11:40.

journal.title: Contact — Lone Survivor
journal.body: Single adult male approached from Birdcage Walk. Non-hostile. Ex-army. Name: Reynolds. Offered basic intel on St James's Park — reports a small group (~6) camped near the lake. Declined to join us. Gave him 3 days rations.

journal.title: Minor Injury — Laceration
journal.body: Right hand laceration during site perimeter work — barbed wire. Cleaned with saline, dressed with sterile gauze. Antibiotics started as precaution (amoxicillin 500mg TDS). Monitor for infection.

journal.title: Security Perimeter Extended
journal.body: Extended inner perimeter to include Palace forecourt. Three additional observation posts established at NW, SW and SE corners. Rota: 2-hour watches, 4-person rotation.

journal.title: Second Run — Pimlico Road
journal.body: Extended range run to Pimlico Road SW1, ~1.1km. Garden centre confirmed abandoned. Recovered: 8 x 20L diesel jerricans (partial — est 85L total), 14 propane canisters, extensive hand tools. Run time: 3h20m. No incidents.

journal.title: LoRa Beacon Received — Day 98
journal.body: Received LoRa packet at 08:12. Signal strength: -78 dBm. Call sign: unknown — likely automated beacon. Bearing ~105°. Could not decode payload fully. Will monitor.

journal.title: Fuel Assessment — Critical Review
journal.body: Diesel reserves: 188L remaining. Generator consumption running at ~3.5L/day on reduced schedule. Vehicle fuel kept in reserve at 28L. At current rate: approx 54 days generator fuel left. Must source more within 30 days.

journal.title: Day 200 Status — Group Intact
journal.body: Full inventory completed. Group of 5 remains healthy. No critical injuries in past 6 weeks. Food estimated 60+ days at current ration. Water collection from roof now operational — averaging 40L/day when raining. Morale stable.

journal.title: Satellite Pass — ISS Visible
journal.body: ISS tracked at 16:04. Elevation peak 62°. No RF emissions detected on 437.800MHz or 145.800MHz. Systems appear dormant. No response to attempted contact. Expected.

journal.title: Today — Routine Morning Check
journal.body: All systems nominal. Temperature 14°C. Light drizzle — roof collection tank open. Generator on 4-hour schedule. No new contacts. Medical: all healthy. Priority today: resupply run planning for Whitehall.

resources.name: Tinned Meat & Fish
resources.notes: Mixed: beef, tuna, chicken, sardines. Stored in basement north wing. Group of 5 — 2 tins/day

resources.name: Dried Pasta & Rice
resources.notes: Pasta 40kg, rice 24kg. Sealed bins. Basement east storeroom.

resources.name: Tinned Vegetables
resources.notes: Mixed: tomatoes, peas, sweetcorn, beans. Basement north wing.

resources.name: Cooking Oil
resources.notes: Sunflower and olive oil. Kitchen stores.

resources.name: Stored Drinking Water
resources.notes: Two IBC tanks ~500L + 5 x 25L jerricans. Outbuilding. Group of 5 @ 3L/day

resources.name: Water Purification Tablets
resources.notes: Aquatabs. 1 tablet per 500ml. Kitchen medical store.

resources.name: Berkey Filter Cartridges
resources.notes: Each filters ~11,000L. Kitchen — Berkey Royal unit. Replace when flow slows noticeably.

resources.name: Diesel (Vehicle)
resources.notes: Land Rover Defender. Reserve for emergency evac only. Do not use for runs unless critical.

resources.name: Diesel (Generator)
resources.notes: 4kW diesel generator on 4h/day schedule. IBC + jerricans in outbuilding.

resources.name: Propane Canisters
resources.notes: Camping Gaz 907 and generic 220g. Used for cooking stove backup. Outbuilding shelf B.

wanted.name: Antibiotics — Broad Spectrum
wanted.notes: Amoxicillin, co-amoxiclav, metronidazole. Sealed packaging only. Check expiry.

wanted.name: Diesel — Generator
wanted.where: Petrol stations — Horseferry Road, Vauxhall Bridge Road
wanted.notes: Use manual siphon pump. Bring 4 x 25L jerricans. Confirm hand pump in kit before run.

wanted.name: Long-range Radio (HF)
wanted.where: Electronics retailers — West End, or military surplus, Tottenham Court Road
wanted.notes: Icom IC-7300 or equivalent. Transceiver only — have antenna. Would significantly extend comms range.

wanted.name: Surgical Supplies
wanted.where: St Thomas' Hospital supply areas, Westminster SW1
wanted.notes: Suture kits, trauma dressings, IV kit, lidocaine. Prioritise over most other runs.

wanted.name: Seeds — Vegetable
wanted.notes: Root veg priority: carrot, parsnip, potato. Brassicas. Non-hybrid / open pollinated where possible.

runs.name: Victoria Street — Day 7
runs.notes: Cleared Sainsbury's Local and adjacent newsagent. 140 tins, 12kg pasta, misc canned goods. No contact. Run successful. Fuel used ~3L.

runs.name: Pimlico Road — Day 67
runs.notes: Garden centre and adjacent hardware stores. 85L diesel (partial jerricans), 14 propane canisters, hand tools, rope, tarpaulins. 3h20m round trip. No incidents. Area clear.

runs.name: Whitehall Pharmacy Run — Planned
runs.notes: Target: pharmacies on Whitehall and Charing Cross area. Priority: antibiotics, surgical supplies, IV kits. Two-person team. Estimated 2h. Abort if any contact.
